title: Steve Jobs: Apple Innovation
description: Design obsession, startups, and the company that put computers in pockets.

questions.question: In what year did Steve Jobs co-found Apple Computer Company with Steve Wozniak?
questions.hint: The same year as America's bicentennial celebration

questions.question: That 1976 garage startup's first mass-produced hit computer was called what?
questions.hint: The Roman numeral for two, this computer had color graphics and was hugely successful

questions.question: After the Apple II era and his ouster, Jobs founded what computer company later acquired by Apple?
questions.hint: It was literally what came 'after' Apple for Jobs, spelled with unusual capitalization

questions.question: NeXT's return to Apple brought what 2007 product that changed smartphones forever?
questions.hint: A phone that starts with 'i' and put the internet in everyone's pocket

questions.question: Before the iPhone era, Jobs ran what animation studio that created Toy Story and sold to Disney?
questions.hint: Named after a computer graphics term, they revolutionized animated movies

imageHint: 🍎 Think different - from garage startup to tech empire 📱

deeperMode.title: The Perfectionist's Obsessions
deeperMode.description: Perfectionism and controversy behind the brand

questions.question: Jobs was famous for his demanding perfectionism. What did he reportedly make his team redesign 67 times for the first iPhone?
questions.hint: The container that holds the product - he wanted the 'unboxing experience' to be perfect

questions.question: What Zen Buddhist practice did Jobs follow that influenced Apple's minimalist design philosophy?
questions.hint: A practice of mental focus and awareness that values simplicity and presence
